description:
Save the current gvSIG project to a specific file path.

gvSIG is already open with a View containing the Natural Earth countries layer (ne_110m_admin_0_countries). The file /home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/world_countries.gvsproj does NOT exist yet. Your task:

1. Use the File menu in the gvSIG menu bar: click 'File' (top-left), then select 'Save as...' from the dropdown.
   NOTE: Do NOT use Ctrl+S — in gvSIG this triggers a 'save before closing' confirmation dialog, not a Save As dialog. Use the menu instead.
2. A Save As file dialog will appear. In the File Name field, type the full path: /home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/world_countries.gvsproj
3. Click the 'Save' button to save the project.
4. The window title will update to show 'world_countries.gvsproj' confirming the save was successful.

The task is complete when the file /home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/world_countries.gvsproj exists on disk.
